_comment: The ONE judgment in the pipeline: which eBay category branches count as ENGINE parts (Rule B). A listing whose categoryId is a descendant of any include-ancestor -> Rule B (fitment restricted to the donor's engine). Everything else -> Rule A (whole chassis family). exclude_ids override include (forced Rule A). See docs/DESIGN.md sec 6.1. IDs are eBay US Motors (category_tree 100) top-level branches under 6030, owner-confirmed 2026-08-15.
_default_note: If a listing's category is not in the fetched tree, default to Rule B (narrower/safer).
